morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆，不拆成马来语词缀。e 为 e taling，读 /e/；c 读 /t͡ʃ/。输入未提供音节和 Jawi，相关字段保留 null；读音可分为 be.ca。

senses.zh_definition: 由车夫踩踏驱动、通常供一至两名乘客乘坐的人力三轮车。
senses.en_definition: A pedal-powered three-wheeled vehicle carrying one or two passengers; a trishaw or pedicab.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis kenderaan beroda tiga untuk seorang atau dua penumpang yang dikayuh oleh seseorang.
senses.nuances: 本条采用输入所指定的《Kamus Dewan》三轮脚踏载客车义。berbeca 表示乘坐这种车；mengayuh beca 表示踩踏驾驶。tukang beca 是传统称呼，pengayuh beca 则直接说明职业活动。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=beca)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Program tersebut bertujuan meningkatkan pendapatan pengayuh beca melalui aktiviti pelancongan warisan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该计划旨在通过文化遗产旅游活动，提高人力三轮车夫的收入。
dual_scenarios.en: The programme aims to increase trishaw riders' earnings through heritage tourism activities.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Nak naik beca tak? Kita pusing kawasan ni je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Awak hendak menaiki beca? Kita bersiar-siar di kawasan ini sahaja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 要不要坐三轮车？我们就在这一带逛逛。
dual_scenarios.en: Fancy a trishaw ride? We'll just go around this area.

etymology.historical_story: Beca reflects the exchange of everyday vocabulary between Malay and Hokkien speakers. Singapore's National Library identifies it among Hokkien words absorbed into Malay, while its established Malay meaning names a pedal-powered passenger vehicle. The word offers a compact reminder that familiar transport vocabulary can preserve the history of multilingual contact. [National Library Singapore](https://biblioasia.nlb.gov.sg/files/pdf/vol-6/issue-4/v6-issue4_PluralitySolidarity.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 bé-ca，想象车夫踩踏板，载你慢慢逛老街：beca 就是人力三轮车。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 称呼年长车夫时，可根据对方年龄与场合使用 pak cik 等尊称；直接交流时用 encik 也合适。tukang beca 本身不是辱称，但应避免轻视职业的语气。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 乘车前先确认路线、时长、总价及计费方式。拍摄车夫或近距离拍摄其车辆装饰时，先征求同意较为得体。
